The name Azubah is also associated with the concept of abandonment, as it is derived from the root 'azab', which means to forsake or abandon. In this sense, Azubah represents a woman who has abandoned her old life and has found new strength and beauty in her faith. In modern times, Azubah has become a popular name in Christian cultures, representing a strong and beautiful woman who is a leader and a protector, and who embodies the qualities of a strong and beautiful woman of faith.
